name: Advance Switchboard Distribution

about:
Advance Switchboard Distribution (ASD) was founded in 2005 in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, a suburb of Chicago. The privately held company began as a UL-listed power distribution systems manufacturer focused on custom low-voltage switchboards and panelboards.

ASD designs and builds UL 891 low-voltage switchboards, UL 67 panelboards, and NEMA 1 and 3R enclosures at its manufacturing facility in Elk Grove Village. The shop provides custom design/build engineering, including site visits to tailor gear to space constraints and utility code requirements. The company emphasizes quick turnaround, claiming lead times 8 to 10 weeks faster than national competitors.

ASD serves electrical contractors and end users across distribution warehousing (e-commerce fulfillment centers, cold storage, self-storage), multi-tenant and mixed-use construction in Chicago’s Loop and Fulton Market, education (universities and K‑12 schools), healthcare (hospitals and outpatient centers), EV charging infrastructure (dealerships, fleet depots), and renewable power projects (community solar, rooftop and behind-the-meter installations).

The company differentiates itself through a leadership team with backgrounds at Eaton, Siemens, and Russelectric, collectively offering over 100 years of switchgear experience. ASD highlights its American-made production, responsiveness throughout the design/build phase, and deep expertise in utility and NEC compliance.
